scope: Visible browser media and DOM regions. Model categories/boxes are estimates; page labels are untrusted claims. Pixel tracking uses Java appearance matching, not personal identification.
declaration: Local development fixtures. Pilot local-model outputs inspected before this declaration; do not present these as untouched benchmark results.

required: Actual local vision on real image pixels; no DOM labels in inference
Outlines and discontinuous trails follow actual observations
Full occlusion produces lost, then reacquired, never invented visible boxes
Explicit user-drawn appearance persists and recognizes translated/scaled sample after restart
No recognition claim before taught example exists
Source navigation interrupts and requires explicit rebinding
Named skill reuses a fresh selected source and verifies a real report
modelReferenceAcceptance: IoU0.5 reported separately from workflow completion; failed model grounding is retained, not claimed accurate
learningScope: Explicit user-drawn appearance templates take priority when a strong distinct match exists. Model weights and generic category recognition are not trained.
